error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the SNCF open data feed.
error.invalid_feed: The SNCF open data feed answered with unexpected data.

user.title: SNCF Open Data
user.description:
Follow SNCF trains (TER, Intercités, TGV) with the official open data: timetable, delays, cancellations and service alerts. No account or API key is needed.

Once set up, add your routes from the integration page.

data_description.realtime_interval: How often delays and cancellations are checked while a route window is close or open. Each check downloads about 450 kB.
data_description.platforms: Platforms are not in the SNCF open data. This option reads them from the Gares & Connexions departure boards, an undocumented source that may stop working at any time. Everything else keeps working when it fails.

abort.entry_not_loaded: The integration is not loaded yet. Try again in a moment.

error.same_station: Pick at least one destination different from the departure station.
error.end_before_start: The end of the window must be after its start (windows across midnight are not supported).
error.already_configured: This route is already followed with the same window.

user.title: Stations
user.description: Type the station names. Direct trains from the departure station to any of the destinations are followed.

data_description.destinations_query: One or more names separated by commas, for example: Rabastens, St Sulpice

schedule.title: When
schedule.description: Trains leaving the departure station in this time window are followed, on the chosen days. Realtime data is checked from one hour before the window until 30 minutes after.

data_description.delay_threshold: A train is reported as late from this delay, and again when its delay moves by this much.
data_description.max_trains: Maximum number of upcoming trains in the sensor attributes.

reconfigure.title: Change the route
reconfigure.description: The stations cannot be changed; add a new route for other stations.

data_description.delay_threshold: A train is reported as late from this delay, and again when its delay moves by this much.
data_description.max_trains: Maximum number of upcoming trains in the sensor attributes.
